status: additive-operational-preflight; not the held shared website standard v3
rule: Capture actual rejection evidence, exact operation/resource/permission scope and remediation before future attempts. Never transfer approval between sites, repos, secrets, environments or manifests. Do not retry or bypass a held action. Failed/missing preflight blocks only the affected operation; independent permitted work and working publishers continue. A preflight pass never suppresses provider/automatic review or guarantees approval.

cases.reason: Persistent GitHub Actions schedule, contents:write and unattended main pushes were not specifically authorized; reviewer treated contents:write as a broad unattended mutation surface despite fixed git-add paths. General working-roles authorization did not cover this exact persistent scope.
repair: Preserve disabled writer; do not reset main to held old commit
Prepare exact refreshed workflow on current main with concurrency, paths, retry and no unrelated rights
Require resource-specific authorization for persistent contents:write/main push before enabling
Public read-only discovery may continue independently

resource.credentialRef: existing-preview-database-credential; exact private secret identity remains in owning provider record

cases.reason: Adding the existing preview database credential to production expands persistent production access; the reviewed authorization did not cover that exact secret configuration.
repair: Prepare exact project, environment, secret identity, database grants and rollback
Require approval of this credential promotion independently of frontend release
Verify production call and separately matched durable receipt only after approved configuration

cases.reason: Large unreviewed code and portfolio-operations payload, including public endpoints, workflows and site inventory, without trusted authorization for this exact release/destination.
repair: Keep v3 bundle and canonical policy activation held
Review exact thirty-file manifest and corrected patch
Reconcile newer main without overwriting it
Obtain exact release/destination authorization, then preview and deployment verification

cases.reason: Automatic approval review rejected the production update because it included 43 generated files. The owner began narrowing it to duplicate record, discovery feeds/pages and redirect; current approval remains unresolved.
repair: Do not replay the rejected broad generated-file update
Review a minimal exact diff and article-data/config invariants
Preserve sole writer and current main
Resolve exact review before any held production update; continue independent source work

cases.reason: Automatic review rejected testing a private SOT URL through a temporary share link, citing possible disclosure of operational configuration.
repair: Do not request private SOT through public temporary share
Inspect configured output boundaries using source and build evidence
Keep private operational contents out of public audit projection
